# Explore Pune

> The Curated Field Guide to Historic Pune — Maratha hill forts, Peshwa-era wadas, sacred sanctuaries, museums, and Sahyadri nature trails.

Explore Pune is an authoritative, verified digital travel journal, itinerary planner, and heritage preservation directory dedicated to Pune and the surrounding Sahyadri region in Maharashtra, India.

## Canonical Domain
- Website: https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app
- Language: English (en) and Marathi (mr)
- Sitemaps: https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/robots.txt

## Primary Public Routes
- [Explore Pune Home](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/): Main heritage explorer directory with real-time filtering, search, and category exploration.
- [Destinations Directory](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/destinations): Curated field guide index of 80+ historic Pune destinations.
- [Historic Forts Guide](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/destinations/forts): Sahyadri mountain strongholds, trekking routes, and Maratha history.
- [Peshwa Wadas Guide](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/destinations/heritage): 18th-century Maratha wadas and wooden palaces.
- [Sacred Temples Guide](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/destinations/temples): Ancient Hemadpanthi, rock-cut, and sacred shrines.
- [Museums Guide](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/destinations/museums): Antiquities, social reform memorials, and cultural galleries.
- [Nature & Lakes Guide](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/destinations/nature): Sahyadri hills, tekdis, lakes, and reservoirs.
- [Food Heritage Guide](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/destinations/food): Authentic Puneri gastronomy, misal, and heritage eateries.
- [Free Entry Guide](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/destinations/free): Verified free admission destinations (₹0 entry).
- [AI Trip Planner](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/planner): Custom daily itinerary generator optimized by duration, companion, travel pace, and transport mode.
- [Pune Community](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/community): Authentic visitor reviews, travel tips, and moderated heritage discussions.
- [Traveller Stories & Blogs](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/blogs): Long-form travelogues and expedition field journals by local explorers.
- [Explorer Milestones](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/milestones): Gamified heritage achievements, visit certificates, and exploration badges.
- [About the Initiative](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/about): Background, mission, and heritage conservation ethics.
- [Data Methodology](https://explore-pune-eosin.vercel.app/data): Archival sources, GIS validation standards, and research methodology.

## Major Verified Destination Entities
- **Sinhagad Fort (कोंढाणा)**: Sahyadri hill fortress at 1,312m elevation; site of the 1670 Battle of Sinhagad fought by Tanaji Malusare.
- **Shaniwar Wada (शनिवार वाडा)**: Historic 18th-century seat of the Peshwa rulers of the Maratha Empire, constructed in 1732 by Peshwa Baji Rao I.
- **Lal Mahal (लाल महाल)**: Historic 1630 palace commissioned by Shahaji Bhosale for Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Jijabai.
- **Raja Dinkar Kelkar Museum**: Collection of 20,000+ Indian antiquities, carvings, and historic musical instruments.
- **Pataleshwar Cave Temple (पाताळेश्वर)**: 8th-century monolithic rock-cut Shiva sanctuary carved from a single basalt rock mass during the Rashtrakuta period.
- **Aga Khan Palace (आगाखान पॅलेस)**: 1892 Italian-arched palace where Mahatma Gandhi and Kasturba Gandhi were interned during the Quit India Movement.
- **Dagdusheth Halwai Ganpati**: World-renowned Ganesh shrine established in 1893.
- **Rajgad Fort**: Sovereign capital of the Maratha Empire under Shivaji Maharaj for over 25 years.
- **Torna Fort (Prachandagad)**: First fort captured by 16-year-old Shivaji Maharaj in 1646.
- **Shivneri Fort**: 1630 birthplace of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj in Junnar.

## Verified Categories
- `forts`: Historic hill fortresses and Maratha military strongholds.
- `wadas`: Peshwa-era residential mansions and civic complexes.
- `temples`: Ancient Hemadpanthi, rock-cut, and sacred pilgrimage sanctuaries.
- `museums`: Art, ethnography, defense, and cultural artifact museums.
- `nature`: Sahyadri hills, tekdis, lakes, and monsoon waterfalls.
- `food`: Authentic Pune culinary heritage (misal, bhakarwadi, mastani, puneri thali).

## Public API Endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/places`: Catalog of verified published destinations with filters for category, keyword, and coordinates.
- `GET /api/v1/health`: System status, uptime, and database connectivity.
- `GET /api/v1/pmpml`: Public bus transit stop routes and transit schedules.
- `GET /api/v1/transit/directions`: Multimodal route calculation between Pune landmarks.
